criteria.verdict_rule: LOOKAHEAD_PRESENT iff the published engine still takes its signal from bar d (`score.loc[d]`) while paying the book from bar d's open to the next bar's open -- a source pin read at run time -- AND pricing the same rule one bar later costs >= tol_pp_per_year; MECHANISM_ABSENT if the engine no longer reads its own bar (the pin flips, the claim must be re-derived); WITHIN_TOL if the pin holds but the one-bar price is under the line

arms.published: open_to_open_equity(score)  -- card convention, signal seen at bar d close, weights earn open[d]->open[d+1]
arms.causal: open_to_open_equity(score.shift(1)) -- same rule on data available at open[d]
arms.ledger: etf_book_forward engine (decide at close d, fill at open d+1, mark to close)

criteria.frozen: threshold and rules written before the first run; --check refuses a face that does not reproduce them

mechanism.test: source pin on etf_robust_pf.open_to_open_equity: the signal is taken from `score.loc[d]` while the book is paid from `op.at[d] -> op.at[nxt]`

decomposition.note: the three components are priced on separate arms: the first is information ordering, the second is open-to-open vs close-to-close marking around an open fill, the third is the repo ladder the ledger credits and the card does not

verdict.rule: LOOKAHEAD_PRESENT iff the published engine still takes its signal from bar d (`score.loc[d]`) while paying the book from bar d's open to the next bar's open -- a source pin read at run time -- AND pricing the same rule one bar later costs >= tol_pp_per_year; MECHANISM_ABSENT if the engine no longer reads its own bar (the pin flips, the claim must be re-derived); WITHIN_TOL if the pin holds but the one-bar price is under the line
verdict.why: the published engine ranks on `score.loc[d]` -- built from bar d's own close and amount -- and then earns open[d]->open[d+1]: the book buys at a price that was set before the information it ranks on. Delaying that information one bar costs 1.14 pp/yr, and the whole ladder is monotone in delay (-2:+15.98, -1:+12.46, +0:+9.60, +1:+8.46, +5:+7.39, +20:+5.09)
